I replied to Ilse in a thread on her message in #north-random. I said I've noted that Quarrendon Freight Lines' 2026 renewal is 100 seats and that I didn't change anything, since she said no action was needed.

One thing in my reply wasn't checked: I told her the old number is still in her #north-team post and suggested she correct it there. I didn't open that channel, so I don't know if she's already edited it. A seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so posting it in the channel was fine.
